rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０３７＿０１Oh!! Hey, hey, you!￥Did you hear yet?＝＠０３７＿０２Eiji collapsed!
＊Amane＊＠０３７＿０４He's in the Medical Room now.￥If you can, you should go￥visit him too.
＊Amane＊＠０３７＿０５I know, right?￥But he did seem kind of￥out of sorts, so...
＊Amane＊＠０３７＿０６Oh, I know!￥Why don't you go check on him?＝＠０３７＿０７Eiji's in the￥Medical Room right now!
＊Amane＊＠０３７＿０８I bet seeing you will￥cheer him right up!
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿０９Huh?￥What're you doing here?￥You feeling sick or something?
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１０Oh, that.￥So you heard too, huh?￥About me keeling over.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１１I'm fine now.￥Man...￥That was so lame of me.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１３Dropping flat in the middle￥of training like that.￥So lame.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１４I didn't think I was worn down￥enough to pass out.￥Surprised myself, honestly.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１５I had a really awful dream this￥morning, and I figured that's￥why I felt so crummy.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１６I thought if I just kept￥running, I could forget it, but￥it didn't work out that way.＝＠０３７＿１７Why'd I have to dream about￥that now, of all times...
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１８Oh...￥It was a long time ago, but...
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿１９Eh, why not.￥I guess I can tell you.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿２１Eh, why not. It's you.￥Sometimes it helps to get￥stuff off your chest.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿２２Believe it or not, back on￥Sophia I was a pretty well-known￥sprinter.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿２３I'd never lost. Not once.￥No matter who I raced, winning￥was just a given.

＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿２４But... at a big track meet six￥months ago, someone passed me￥for the first time...＝＠０３７＿２５The second I realized I was￥running behind someone,￥I got scared...＝＠０３７＿２６And I fell flat on my face.￥It was so... pathetic.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿２７And now, after all this time,￥I dreamed about it. I thought￥I'd put all that behind me.
＊Eiji＊＠０３７＿２９But looking back, maybe it was￥a good thing it happened.＝＠０３７＿３０It made me realize I'd gotten￥way too full of myself.
＊Eiji＊＠０３８＿０２Thanks to that race, I￥realized I'd gotten way too￥full of myself.
＊Eiji＊...＝＠０３８＿０３Right after that race, I heard￥I'd been picked as a candidate.￥I thought it was a joke.＝＠０３８＿０４Me, the guy who lost, making￥the cut?
＊Eiji＊＠０３８＿０５Yeah.￥I'm really glad I made it here.
＊Eiji＊＠０３８＿０７It was a shock back then, but￥in the end... I just can't￥give up running.＝＠０３８＿０８It's too much fun.
＊Eiji＊＠０３８＿０９Y'know, I feel better now￥that I've talked about it.
＊Eiji＊＠０３８＿１１Guess I'd better head back￥to my room.＝＠０３８＿１２See you at training!
